summary.tldr: This bill adds automated external defibrillators and related parts to the list of supplies taxed at 0% under the Excise Tax Act.
what_it_does: Adds automated external defibrillators to the list of zero-rated supplies under the Excise Tax Act.
Adds kits that contain an automated external defibrillator to that zero-rated list.
Adds pads and accessories designed for use with an automated external defibrillator to that zero-rated list.
who_it_affects: Buyers of defibrillators and related kits
summary.background: The bill amends Schedule VI of the Excise Tax Act, which lists supplies that are zero-rated.
